Review

  • CURIE: gmeow:Review
  • IRI: https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/Review
  • Category: class
  • Defined by: gmeow:slices/software

A code review or peer review of a merge request or commit — an InformationObject carrying review text, approval state, and requested changes. The reviewing activity itself is a gmeow:Event with gmeow:Participations.

Structure

Subclass of: gmeow:InformationObject

Practical Pattern

Use gmeow:Review as a specialized kind of gmeow:InformationObject. Add statement metadata or a standpoint when the assertion needs provenance, confidence, or vantage.

Common Companion Terms

gmeow:InformationObject
